scenario_narrative: For a hypothetical manufacturer, teams want to understand how process signals could support earlier investigation of unusual operating conditions.
A planning concept would inventory historian sources, standardize measures, test anomaly rules with operators, and record confidence and limitations before operational use.
Define alert precision, review effort, refresh needs, and ownership with users before setting targets. No performance result is claimed.
title: Illustrative monitoring pipeline planning scenario
